citations.quote: How many total points will be scored in the 3rd quarter?

This market resolves to Yes if Baltimore and Carolina collectively score more than 7.5 points during the 3rd quarter of the Pro Football game between Baltimore and Carolina scheduled for November 22, 2026 at 1:00 PM ET. Otherwise, it resolves to No. The Underlying is the total points scored by both teams during the 3rd quarter of the specified game, excluding all other periods and overtime. Source Agencies, in order, are the league governing body, ESPN, Fox Sports, and the broadcast partner of the event. If the Expiration Value cannot be determined on the Expiration Date (including because the event is cancelled or a team forfeits, withdraws, or is disqualified), the Exchange may determine payouts pursuant to the Market Outcome Review Process. workbook_conflicts: Scale: the README specifies 1-5 per category; the workbook uses 1-3. This prototype uses the workbook's 1-3 scale and 4-12 totals.

Markets!B formula =IF(I>=9,"High",IF(I>=7,"Medium","Low")) ignores the Framework overrides, and SUM() treats a blank score as 0, so an incomplete row shows as Low. The code reports incomplete ratings instead.
Volume column mixes bases: rows 2-4 are event totals from the Gemini API, rows 5-6 are 24h figures from CoinRithm, while Agent rule 4 is written for 24h volume.
Override 'any 3 in Ambiguity or Source -> at least Medium' only changes the result at a raw total of 6 (for example 3+1+1+1); at 7 or more the total is already Medium.
Override 'High (3) in Liquidity -> never trade more than top-of-book' is a trading rule. Verity places no trades, so it becomes a note that the price is an unreliable signal.
Agent action column uses trading verbs (Proceed, Proceed small size). They are mapped to research actions: Low -> no_further_research, Medium -> investigate, High -> flag_for_human_review.
